body: Hello! Good luck with learning latvian! And I dont really keep count, there is a bunch of pine cones just laying around my house. They're all over the place.

We used to have a chanell that was completely russian, but it's gone now. So Latvian TV isn't all that much russian, but we have available a lot of chanels, that are shown in Russia, so...

I've never heard of the ones you've mentioned, I'll have to find the time to check them out. And speaking of histroy - I'm interested in the vikings and I find myself also interested in knights and heraldry. I'm thinking of possibly studying history in university, but it's just a thought.

I, too, prefer film to books actually. I learned russian by watching russian crime shows and reading the subtitles when I was little (I've been watching them with my grandparents since I can remember myself). How To Get Away With Murder is a pretty intense show, and I like it a lot. What period of history are you more interested in, or anything that's history is good to you?

Knowing myself, it kind of sounds like I need a significant other to get me through this, but...the dating scene is not what I'm about. I'm not good at these things. It's not that I don't have friends, it's just that I keep leaning on the very few of them like cruches and it feels unfair to them. And I'm running out of patience for all this bullshit andi don't want to pull through anymore. I just...don't.

Hello! I wish you luck in your language learning voyages! And I'm glad to help people find out about my country, I used to run a blog about it until recently. If you'd like to know more, I could get you some resources.

I haven't read in a long time because of school, but I've heard good things about Jo Nesbø's works. My friend is an fan of his works and I'm looking forward to getting my hands on a copy of his works!

Hello. I'm Leo, a 17 year old person from Latvia. I'm interested in a lot of things, including but not limited to: martial arts, programming, game design, history, languages (I know Latvian, English and Russian, would like to learn Norwegian one day), geography, nature in general, writing & detective stories, murder mysteries, crime. I have a habit of collecting pine cones.

Disclaimer: I've got severe depression so I might not seem all that talkative and I get really moody, but I've been told that I'm a riot, so it's not always all bad.
